channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump administration is examining whether a diesel export ban is feasible, Treasury Secretary says
item.description: Republican lawmakers have called for an export ban as high diesel prices hit farmers and truckers ahead of the November midterm elections.

item.title: Trump administration removes around 760,000 Obamacare enrollments, alleging fraud
item.description: Vice President JD Vance's White House Task Force to Eliminate Fraud estimates the action will save roughly $2.2 billion in taxpayer-funded subsidies.

item.title: Trump discloses more than 1,100 July trades, including up to $25 million each in sales of Microsoft, Amazon
item.description: Trump sold tech stocks including Amazon and Microsoft when the Mag 7 stocks popped on July 20, adding $291 billion in market value in one day.

item.title: Stock futures are little changed after Nasdaq Composite posts fresh record: Live updates
item.description: The Nasdaq Composite rose to a new all-time intraday high and closed at a record on Tuesday.

item.title: U.S. regulators rush to write crypto rulebook after Clarity Act stalls in Senate
item.description: State and federal regulators are rushing to fill the void after comprehensive crypto rules failed to clear the Senate.

item.title: Here's who we know is going to the Trump-Xi dinner so far
item.description: Very little is known about which Chinese business executives, if any, are expected to attend.

item.title: Meta is breaking out after introducing Muse AI agent. Where the stock is going, according to the charts
item.description: Todd Gordon breaks down what's going with Meta Platforms.

item.title: Qantas to start selling tickets next year for its New York to Sydney nonstop flight
item.description: Qantas plans to start selling tickets for its first New York to Sydney nonstop flight.

item.title: ShinyHunters hackers say they breached FBI, stole data on bureau employees
item.description: AI company Anthropic earlier this month said it had caught ​ShinyHunters-linked hackers trying to use its tools.

item.title: Royal Caribbean nears $3 billion deal to take 50% equity stake in Sandals
item.description: Royal Caribbean has been trying to diversify beyond cruises and become a leader overall in vacations.

item.title: Peloton is revamping its treadmills with new features in the next phase of its turnaround
item.description: With its new treadmills, Peloton aims to appeal to customers from casual workers to more serious athletes.

item.title: Autonomous trucking company Aurora looks to accelerate toward profitability
item.description: Aurora's founder and CEO told CNBC the company is targeting positive free cash flow by 2028, driven by a substantial increase in the number autonomous trucks.

item.title: Cisco stock sinks 5% after Piper Sandler cuts price target on growth concerns
item.description: Cisco stock hit a record over the summer, but Piper Sandler analysts expressed concerns that growth is peaking in the industry.

item.title: Wednesday's big stock stories: What’s likely to move the market in the next trading session
item.description: The S&P 500 closed marginally lower Tuesday, but the index is just 0.7% off from its all-time high. Oil prices fell for a fifth straight day.

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI roll out cheaper models in first release since call for slowdown
item.description: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. Anthropic unveiled Claude Opus 5.5.

item.title: Sullivan: Wall Street admits it doesn't know where oil is headed. There's one stock they do agree on
item.description: JPMorgan’s commodity team admitted what many are thinking on the Iran situation and oil: We just don't know.

item.title: Lennar shares pop as Berkshire builds almost a 10% stake in beleaguered homebuilder
item.description: The conglomerate built by Warren Buffett and led today by Greg Abel holds a sizable stake in Miami-based homebuilder Lennar.

item.title: U.S. strikes Greenland deal at UN to expand military presence at Arctic outposts
item.description: Trump said the agreement with Greenland and Denmark would give the U.S. "permanent control over security" in the Danish island territory.

item.title: No new stock highs, no problem: Options traders bet they're coming in these names
item.description: Options activity shows traders anticipate fresh highs are around the corner for a handful of names.

item.title: Trump slams Iran and Cuba, defends AI growth in boastful UN speech
item.description: The U.S. "will no longer permit threats to America to gain a foothold anywhere in the Western Hemisphere," Trump told the UN leaders.

item.title: A top chip stock analyst sees big things for Nvidia, Broadcom. How his case aligns with ours
item.description: The bullish sentiment comes despite calls to slow down AI model development and rekindled investor enthusiasm for a competing part of the AI chip ecosystem.

item.title: $2.5 billion Amazon Prime settlement update: See if you qualify for a $200 payout and learn how to cancel unwanted subscriptions
item.description: Under a revised FTC order, more Amazon users qualify for a refund and the maximum payout been raised from $51 to $200.

item.title: Nvidia options are doing something unusual ahead of two catalysts. Here's how one trader is playing it

item.title: Climate risk is reshaping muni credit — and income opportunities

item.title: Iran reportedly says it can reopen Strait of Hormuz within 7 days if U.S. eases military pressure
item.description: The reports raised hopes of renewed U.S.-Iran diplomacy, with U.S. stock futures mixed and oil prices lower.

item.title: Democrats lead the polls. Republicans lead in cash heading into the midterms
item.description: Republicans hold a $103 million cash advantage across national party committees as the fight for control of Congress enters its final six weeks.

item.title: Trump snaps at CNN at United Nations: 'You should not be here covering me'
item.description: CNN, MS NOW and Politico are challenging Trump's ban of them from the White House with a lawsuit alleging he violated their First Amendment rights.

item.title: McDonald's is hosting an investor day as its U.S. business struggles. Here are 4 things to expect
item.description: The presentation comes as McDonald's U.S. business disappointed in its most recent quarter.

item.title: Trump, Xi seek trade stability and deals, but AI, tariffs and Iran loom large. What to watch

item.title: Kalshi asks CFTC to allow margin trading on its platform, letting users buy with borrowed funds
item.description: It's the latest move by the company as it and other event contract exchanges seek to gain greater participation by institutional traders.
